title: Cooling
text: Cooling. I am fascinated with these cooling blankets! I was hoping that this would fit the king bed, but it doesn't quite do so. It's close though, there's just no hang over on the sides. The blanket does have a cooling effect. I'm a menopausal woman and every once in a while, I have challenges sleeping because I'm too warm. This is helpful on those nights. It's cooler than sleeping with no blanket and having the fan on.
